note: Canonical pinned training-environment contract (BUG-301). Single source of truth for OPTIONAL local-training dependencies — discovery never installs; only TrainingEnvironmentManager.install() acts on it, and only after explicit operator opt-in. 'packages' is the pinned torch build (exact +cpu/+cu local tag enforced); 'runtime' lists the application stack the training payload actually imports, pinned to the release's requirements.lock. Versions were validated against the release's tested matrix.

python.guidance: Install Python 3.11-3.13 (x64) from python.org, check 'Add to PATH', relaunch Nexus, press Re-check.

cuda.driver_policy: CUDA 12.x minor-version compatibility floor (Table 2). Passing this floor is necessary, not sufficient: real CUDA allocation/matmul must also pass. PTX/new-feature requirements can require a newer driver.

smoke.cpu_tensor: torch.ones(64,70) @ torch.randn(70,3) must produce finite output
smoke.cuda: torch.cuda.is_available() AND a real allocation + matmul on 'cuda:0' with device-name readback
